_doc: Hand-maintained aliases, embedded in sc-data at build time. 'target' is the starmap.json UUID (stable across patches); 'target_name' is only a sanity check, a mismatch is reported as a load note. 'alt_names' are other names of the location itself, 'venues' are named places inside it (spaceports, admin offices...). Names already derived from labels.json can stay here as a safety net. See docs/data-sources.md.
